programme.desc: Brand new series: Walter Presents - which showcases the best foreign language drama from around the world - features this darkly atmospheric Swedish series in which a mother reunites her three adult children and forces them to confront the family secrets buried in their past. A beautiful island in the Swedish Alandic archipelago is home to a popular lodge, run by Anna-Lisa Waldemar and her youngest son Oskar. Mysteriously, Anna-Lisa has summoned her eldest son Lasse and her daughter Jonna home - it's the first time the family have been together in years. Despite the idyllic setting, the homecoming is full of conflict, arousing old memories, resentments and secrets. No one knows why they have been brought back and all three siblings are keen for the weekend to be over. However, her children are unaware that Anna-Lisa has a hidden agenda and a plan that is set to change their lives for ever. Starring Joel Spira, Bjorn Bengtsson, Aliette Opheim, Stina Ekblad, Torkel Pettersson, Jessica Grabowsky, Saga Sarkola, Molly Nutley and Tobias Zilliacus. In Swedish with English subtitles.

programme.title: Bundesliga. "Bayern" - "Mainz"
programme.desc: Germany has the most attended football league in the world, in the Bundesliga. We bring these authentic fab experiences to your living room with all the key moments of the 2019-20 season, to ensure that your appetite for German football is well and truly met. The likes of Borussia Dortmund and Bayern Munich are met with stern competition this season, as RB Leipzig look to build on their third-placed finish from last season. This programme brings all the games of the german top-flight into one place, so that you can easily catch up with the week's action. As we reach the business end-of-the-season, watch the victors and losers dictate the final table. With relegation spots and Champions League places yet to be decided, it promises to be a rather exciting conclusion for all those concerned.

programme.title: LaLiga. "Celta" - "Athletic"
programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. It is administered by the National Professional Football League and has 20 contestants, with the three lowest-placed teams at the end of each season relegated to the Segunda División and replaced by the top two teams and a play-off winner in that division. Nine teams have become champions, Real Madrid has got the title 33 times and FC Barcelona 26 times. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. "Olympiacos" - "Valencia"
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Vimbldonas. Official Film
programme.desc: Wimbledon is more than just a tennis tournament — it's a summer tradition, a slice of British culture, and one of the most iconic sporting events in the world. Held every year in London, England, usually in late June to early July, it's where the best tennis players on the planet come to battle it out on the famous grass courts of the All England Club. It's actually the oldest tennis tournament in the world, dating back to 1877, and it's still the only Grand Slam played on grass — the fastest and most unpredictable surface. That's part of what makes it so exciting. Matches are intense, fast-paced, and full of surprises. Wimbledon is packed with unique traditions that make it stand out. Players are required to wear all white on court — no exceptions. The crowd enjoys strawberries and cream, and you won't see flashy ads around the court — it's all about the game. And of course, there's the Royal Box, where you might spot celebrities or even members of the British Royal Family watching the action. From rising stars to tennis legends, everyone dreams of lifting the famous Wimbledon trophy. There's something magical about seeing players walk onto Centre Court, hearing the roar of the crowd, and witnessing moments that go down in sports history. Whether you're a tennis fan or just love great sports drama, Wimbledon is a must-watch — classy, thrilling, and full of unforgettable moments.

programme.title: Killer Whale Chronicles
programme.desc: Orcas are the rulers of the seas. These majestic marine mammals have captured the hearts of people with their intelligence and complex family structures. However, since killer whales started attacking boats near Gibraltar, many are asking: Are they threatening us or just playing? The central revelation is that orcas, with specialized "cultures," perfectly exploit the richness of the seas. Surprisingly, there are different orca cultures around the globe. This episode also showcases impressive images of how the curious whales create genuine "fashions," and meet for mating. Their family groups are led by experienced matriarchs who maintain lifelong bonds with their offspring, particularly their sons. Singer and orca enthusiast Sarah Connor lends her voice to the documentary, giving the orcas' stories a special depth.

programme.title: Killer Whale Chronicles

Coastal fog hits glacier-capped mountains, drenching the land in record rainfall and giving rise to temperate rainforests. This unique landscape hosts a rich biodiversity, including the endemic Olympic Marmot, Roosevelt elk, bobcats and one of the last Pacific salmon runs in the lower 48.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The Pol's rush to prepare for their farm's first Michigan winter. The family goes into hyperdrive to fix the pasture fence and finish building the garden hardscape before the first snow falls. Beth is worried about the bees, so she brings in some expert help to hopefully ensure their survival.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: It's winter on the farm, and the Pol's are adding to their flock! The family is bringing in four merino ewes that were recently bred, which means with any luck the farm could be expecting its first lambs come springtime. And as winter fades into spring, the Pol's prepare for the new arrivals by building a lambing pen. Meanwhile, Beth checks if her bees survived the winter.

programme.title: Wild Chile
programme.desc: The natural beauty of Chile is explored in this fascinating three-part documentary series from National Geographic, travelling the length, and width, of this unique, slender South American country. Each episode focusses on a particular ecosystem and the animals that have adapted to their environments. From the freezing waters that surround the Antarctic Peninsula and Tierra del Fuego, to the dryness of the Atacama Desert, which receives less precipitation than any other area on Earth, excluding the polar regions, the show highlights the unforgiving landscapes where animals and wildlife have had to adapt in order to survive.

programme.title: National Parks: USA
programme.desc: Zion's iconic landscapes feature soaring red spires against a clear blue sky. Beyond canyons and cliffs, water emerges as a surprising force. The humble Virgin River, sculpting a geologic masterpiece over millennia, sustains diverse life in Zion National Park. Climbers, bighorn sheep, wild turkeys, and globe mallow bees all find refuge alongside this flowing lifeline.

programme.title: National Parks: USA
programme.desc: Experience a year in Yellowstone, the worlds first national park. Meet remarkable wildlife, from the steadfast Wapiti wolves and resilient bison to playful grizzly cubs. Discover the parks indigenous heritage, ecological diversity, and geological wonders. Home to the largest collection of geysers on the planet, this American trailblazer shapes how we value and safeguard our most precious lands.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: Reality show follows Dutch-born veterinarian Jan Pol, his family and employees' everyday. programme.title: Crocodile - Australia's Greatest Survivor
programme.desc: In Australia, dominant saltwater crocodiles, called ""boss crocs," are the largest and most powerful animals on the continent. Even after unrelenting human pressure on their very survival, they are still the masters of their world. Over the last 200 years, the impact of human activities—such as commercial hunting, agriculture and population growth—pushed them to the brink of extinction. Today, these "boss crocs" have continued to not only survive but thrive.

programme.title: Croc Wars: Grumeti Vs Mara
programme.desc: Each year, nearly two million wildebeest and zebra cross the Serengeti on a quest for fresh grazing. But two legendary rivers stand in their way—the Grumeti and the Mara—each ruled by a formidable dynasty of Nile crocodiles. In "Croc Wars," follow these ancient predators as they prepare for the feast of the year, but not all crocodiles are created equal. In the deep, fast waters of the Mara, privilege reigns, kills come easy, and food is plentiful. In the rugged Grumeti, crocodiles must outwit, adapt and fight for every scrap. From brutal ambushes to stolen kills, this is a high-stakes battle for survival on two rivers with two strategies and only one chance to eat.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Indigenous educator Phil Breslin ventures into Australia's notorious wetlands to discover three animals built for the muggy and wet environment. Phil comes face to face with the uniquely Australian freshwater crocodile, a massive predatory fish called the barramundi, and the saltwater crocodile, one of the world's most dangerous animals and largest reptiles.

programme.title: Wild Argentina: Extreme Earth
programme.desc: Water shapes northern Argentina, creating paradises for unique wildlife. Whether it's sooty swifts swooping through waterfall floodwaters, frogs glowing in the dark, cute coati families in the undergrowth, or mighty anacondas on the prowl. Argentina's wetlands hold many wonders. In magnificent images, the film celebrates Argentina's water-rich north as a hotspot of biodiversity and shows how drought and fires threaten the fragile ecosystem.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The Pol's are preparing for sheep to give birth, which means figuring out how to catch and shear their four Merino ewes - no small task as this is new territory for everyone except Dr. Pol. Then, while helping his dad on a farm call, Charles has a terrifying accident. The whole family rallies together to care for Charles and take care of the farm.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: It's been a year of farming for the Pol family. Even with Charles recovering from his injury, the farm's showing no signs of slowing down! Beth takes the next step with her bees to grow the colony and harvest honey. Charles and Ben come up with a final fix for the sheep hut's drainage problem. The whole family comes together to plant the garden and celebrate a successful year on the farm.

programme.title: Wild Argentina: Extreme Earth
programme.desc: Whether right whales, penguins or sea lions - for the birth of their young, many marine creatures are drawn to Argentina's nearly 5,000 kilometer coastline. From their very first breath, it's all about one thing for the little ones: survival. Orcas hunt for young sea lions with a special technique and seagulls fly merciless aerial attacks on baby whales. Extraordinary underwater images and impressive animal behavior make the film by Christian Baumeister a visual experience.

programme.title: Wild Argentina: Extreme Earth
programme.desc: In Argentina's breathtaking, yet imposing wilderness, every day is a fight for survival. The terrain is rugged and parched. The air is thin. The weather can change in an instant. And then there are the predators. A female puma stalks a valley in search of guanaco, while a tarantula defends itself against a hungry armadillo. Foxes will scavenge what they can…until one of the world's largest vultures shows up. All the while, in the background, glaciers greedily hold on to the freshwater these animals so desperately need.

programme.title: Croatia's Coast
programme.desc: More than a mere holiday destination, the islands, mountains and forests of the Croatian coast reveal a world of unexpected wildlife and hidden natural treasures. Majestic raptors ride the winds while cicadas sing; geckos defy gravity and the blenny tidal pool-hops. In the mountains, the chamois, lynx and brown bears roam the Velebit range against the backdrop of the breathtaking Adriatic Sea.

programme.title: Hunters of the Reef
programme.desc: Tropical coral reefs are the picture of colorful, light-dappled tranquility - but that's a scuba diver's perspective. To the scaly and gilled inhabitants, it's a fish-eat-fish environment ruled by pods of dolphins who prowl the area at mealtimes while everyone else runs for cover. Incredible weapons, camouflage, venomous defenses and exceptional strategies have evolved among the smaller hunters in constant competition. Lionfish hunt in packs, injecting any objectors with venom from their frilly spikes. The mantis shrimp has polarized vision and the fastest jab on the planet. Cuttlefish morph their skin to match the sand, then attack with tentacle harpoons. The hunt is on in the shifting tides!

programme.title: Secrets of the Penguins

As the planet rapidly warms, he discovers bonds forged from birth between family, friends and strangers are the difference between life and death.

programme.title: Secrets of the Penguins
programme.desc: Millions of years ago, a group of penguins left the ice in search of more. They were tested to the extreme, becoming perhaps the smartest of them all. National Geographic Explorer Bertie Gregory discovers penguin problem solving, 'talking', and their enduring search for new worlds.

programme.title: Sharks Up Close with Bertie Gregory

programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

Now Hazel not only has to save picture day, but also stop a pudding apocalypse! // Hoping to win "Most Spirited Hair" for School Spirit Week, Hazel wishes her hair had spirit! Cosmo and Wanda take this literally and give her hair a spirit, bringing it to life as Diana the Diva! When Hazel and Diana "butt heads" over how best to showcase her, Diana runs away. Hazel chases her all over town but can't catch her. Later, Diana shows up at Hazel's school aiming to enter the contest on her own. Hazel must find a way to reconcile with Diana if she hopes to win Diana back and win the contest.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The Penguins of Madagascar is an American animated television series, a spin-off of the Madagascar films. The main characters are penguins-commandoes: Skipper, Rico, Kowalski, and Private. They pretend to be white and fluffy but in reality are fearless adrenaline addicts and a secret spy team on a mission to protect their home in the Central Park Zoo. The penguins often have to deal with problems caused by their zoo lemur neighbors- King Julien XIII, Maurice and Mort. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: Football: French Ligue 1
programme.desc: PSG, AS Monaco, Marseille, Olympique Lyonnais & Lille... just to name a few. Ligue 1 is currently full of well-organised football teams and incredible European talent, who are a complement to the sport. As the highest professional division in France, it has established itself as one of the top five leagues on the continent. Lyon are the most successful team in regards to consecutive titles, whereas PSG and AS Monaco have managed to propel themselves to the highest achievements in the league, with calculated foreign investment. With the latter coming from a principality, Ligue 1 is another example of a domestic league that provides cross-border competition. From southern wine-growing regions such as Bordeaux, to the historically renowned capital of Paris, we cover the whole of France.

programme.title: Football: LaLiga
programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. It is administered by the National Professional Football League and has 20 contestants, with the three lowest-placed teams at the end of each season relegated to the Segunda División and replaced by the top two teams and a play-off winner in that division. Nine teams have become champions, Real Madrid has got the title 33 times and FC Barcelona 26 times. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

programme.title: Football: Bundesliga
programme.desc: Germany has the most attended football league in the world, in the Bundesliga. We bring these authentic fab experiences to your living room with all the key moments of the 2019-20 season, to ensure that your appetite for German football is well and truly met. As we reach the business end-of-the-season, watch the victors and losers dictate the final table. With relegation spots and Champions League places yet to be decided, it promises to be a rather exciting conclusion for all those concerned.

programme.desc: Leone d’oro a Venezia 1996 per il regista Neil Jordan e Coppa Volpi a Liam Neeson, leader guerrigliero nell'Irlanda lacerata e insanguinata dalle lotte del movimento indipendentista. Uscito di prigione dove era stato rinchiuso in seguito agli scontri armati di Dublino del 1916, Collins continua la sua lotta contro il dominio britannico, riuscendo a fare proseliti grazie al suo carisma. Intanto insieme a un gruppo di militanti, organizza attacchi e azioni di sabotaggio contro il governo che non esiterà a usare anche mezzi poco leciti per intimidirlo.

programme.title: Potere assoluto
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood dirige e interpreta, al fianco di Gene Hackman, un thriller da antologia. Luther Whitney è un vero artista del furto, nessuna cassaforte o serratura può resistergli, ma ormai sta diventando anziano e ha deciso di ritirarsi dopo un ultimo colpo. Deve però fare i conti con un imprevisto perché la padrona della casa che Luther ha deciso di svaligiare non è partita con il marito, per intrattenersi con il suo amante che non è altri che il Presidente degli Stati Uniti. Quando la donna muore, la polizia prova a insabbiare il caso, ma per farlo occorre far tacere l'unico testimone. Eastwood e Hackman di nuovo uno contro l'altro, come ne "Gli spietati".

Un potere magico che ha un solo effetto collaterale, tutt'altro che secondario: per ogni personaggio che prende vita, una persona reale sparisce in un libro. Che ora, dopo aver trovato "Inkheart", libro fantasy sul Medioevo, forse potrà tornare finalmente a casa. Tratto da un romanzo di Cornelia Funke.

programme.title: Dog Man
programme.desc: Il marchio DreamWorks su un film d'animazione tratto dai libri a fumetti per bambini di Dav Pilkey. Feriti in un incidente, un cane poliziotto e il suo collega umano sono sottoposti a un intervento che li fonde insieme. Nasce Dog Man, creatura ibrida al servizio della città contro un malvagio gatto arancione.

programme.title: Belle & Sebastien - Amici per sempre
programme.desc: Terzo avventuroso capitolo tratto dal romanzo di Cecile Aubry. Un uomo sostiene di essere il proprietario di Belle; ma Sebastien farà di tutto per non separarsi dalla fedele amica.

programme.title: Inkheart - La leggenda di Cuore d'inchiostro
programme.desc: Brendan Fraser ed Helen Mirren in un'entusiasmante avventura fantasy. Una ragazzina di 12 anni e suo padre hanno la straordinaria capacità di rendere umani i personaggi dei romanzi. programme.desc: Avventura nella preistoria firmata DreamWorks. Alla ricerca di un rifugio dopo un terremoto, il cavernicolo Grug e la sua famiglia scoprono un mondo popolato da fantastiche creature.

programme.title: French Connection
programme.desc: Pallottole e droga nella Marsiglia degli anni 70 in un action con il premio Oscar Jean Dujardin. Un temerario giudice conduce un'ostinata battaglia contro un padrino della malavita.

programme.title: Body Cam
programme.desc: Mary J. Blige in un thriller avvolto in un pauroso mistero. Un’agente di polizia di Los Angeles indaga sull’inspiegabile morte di un collega, avvenuta durante un controllo di routine. Il suo unico indizio è un filmato che lascia supporre l’esistenza di una creatura soprannaturale.

programme.title: Trap
programme.desc: M. Night Shyamalan scrive e dirige un thriller con Josh Hartnett. Un uomo accompagna la figlia adolescente al concerto di una famosa popstar, ma scopre che l'evento è una trappola organizzata dalla polizia per catturare un serial killer noto come 'Il macellaio'.

programme.title: Nella valle della violenza
programme.desc: Ethan Hawke e John Travolta in un western assetato di vendetta. Per portare a termine la sua missione, un misterioso vagabondo attraversa il deserto per raggiungere una cittadina mineraria.

programme.title: Io sono leggenda
programme.desc: Cult di fantascienza con Will Smith. Un virus ha decimato l'umanita' trasformando i superstiti in mostri. Uno scienziato immune al morbo studia una cura nel suo laboratorio.

programme.title: Il cecchino
programme.desc: Action di Michele Placido con Daniel Auteuil, Mathieu Kassovitz e Luca Argentero. Un misterioso tiratore scelto prende di mira i poliziotti durante l'arresto di una banda di criminali.

programme.title: Immaculate - La prescelta
programme.desc: Nell'abisso della follia in un horror con Sydney Sweeney e Benedetta Porcaroli. In un convento di clausura nella campagna italiana, una giovane e vergine novizia americana scopre di essere incinta. Le consorelle gridano al miracolo, ma il monastero cela segreti indicibili.

programme.title: Chi è senza peccato - The Dry
programme.desc: Eric Bana nel thriller tratto dal romanzo di Jane Harper. Non convinto dalla versione ufficiale dei fatti, un poliziotto torna nella sua citta' per indagare sul suicidio di un amico.

programme.title: La donna che visse due volte
programme.desc: Il tema del doppio in un thriller diabolico di Alfred Hitchcock con James Stewart e Kim Novak. Incaricato di sorvegliare una donna enigmatica, un detective scivola in una spirale di follia.

programme.title: Vetro
programme.desc: Thriller voyeuristico con Carolina Sala, opera prima di Domenico Croce. Una ragazza che vive isolata nella sua stanza si convince che nel palazzo di fronte si sia consumato un crimine.

programme.title: MaXXXine
programme.desc: Capitolo finale della trilogia horror di Ti West con Mia Goth. 1985: Maxine Minx è un'attrice hard che sogna di sfondare a Hollywood. Il ruolo in un ambizioso film horror può essere la svolta, ma una figura misteriosa emerge dal suo passato, mentre un serial killer insanguina la città.

programme.title: Scomparsa
programme.desc: Amanda Seyfried a caccia dell'assassino in un thriller psicologico. Tornata a casa dal lavoro Jill scopre che sua sorella, Molly, e' stata rapita. Come poteva accadere a lei un anno prima, quando riusci' a fuggire dal misterioso aggressore che adesso sembra tornato in azione. Gia', perche' Jill e' convinta che dietro la scomparsa della sorella ci sia la stessa persona. Considerata paranoica dalla polizia, Jill non ha altra scelta per uscire da quest'incubo: indagare da sola per trovare il rapitore di sua sorella prima che sia troppo tardi.

programme.title: The Nest (Il nido)
programme.desc: Horror d'atmosfera, esordio alla regia di Roberto De Feo. Una giovane domestica scardina il mistero insondabile di una villa, dove un bambino paraplegico vive con la severa madre.

programme.title: Ida Red
programme.desc: Crime-thriller con Frank Grillo, Josh Hartnett e Melissa Leo. In prigione per omicidio, la matriarca di una famiglia del crimine tesse le fila della malavita dal carcere.

programme.title: Countdown
programme.desc: Un implacabile conto alla rovescia scandisce un thriller con Elizabeth Lail. Quinn Harris, una giovane infermiera, scarica sul suo smartphone una app che afferma di predire il minuto esatto della morte di ognuno e scopre di avere solamente due giorni di vita. Lo scetticismo e il pensiero razionale non sembrano arginare il suo terrore perché chiunque altro abbia scaricato la stessa app muore nel momento indicato sul display. Quale mistero soprannaturale si nasconde dietro questo macabro fenomeno? Ed è possibile cambiare il proprio destino? Quinn ha poco tempo per cercare la risposta.

programme.title: Chi è senza peccato - The Dry
programme.desc: Eric Bana nel thriller tratto dal romanzo di Jane Harper. Non convinto dalla versione ufficiale dei fatti, un poliziotto torna nella sua citta' per indagare sul suicidio di un amico.

programme.title: L'uomo invisibile
programme.desc: Elisabeth Moss in un horror targato Blumhouse che rispolvera il personaggio creato da H.G. Wells. Cecilia e' sposata con Adrian Griffin, uno scienziato tanto brillante quanto psicopatico e maniaco del controllo. Una relazione tossica da cui la donna finalmente riesce a fuggire. Ma Cecilia si sente ancora perseguitata e sospetta che il vendicativo e geniale consorte sia una presenza invisibile nella sua vita. A ragione, Griffin ha elaborato un subdolo piano per tornare a terrorizzarla. Scritto e diretto da Leigh Whannell, sceneggiatore di alcuni capitoli della saga di "Saw - L'enigmista'.

programme.title: L'uomo che sapeva troppo
programme.desc: Geniale thriller di Alfred Hitchcock con James Stewart e Doris Day. Una coppia in vacanza in Marocco riceve confidenze top secret da un agente colpito a morte. Oscar per la migliore canzone.

programme.title: The Wasp
programme.desc: Naomie Harris e Natalie Dormer, una delle star de "Il Trono di Spade", in un intricato thriller psicologico dalla suspense serrata. Stufa di subire le prepotenze del marito, Heather ricontatta dopo molti anni una ex compagna di scuola per proporle di uccidere l'uomo.

programme.title: Good Kill
programme.desc: Dal regista di "Lord Of War", un thriller con Ethan Hawke. Un pilota di droni bombarda senza pieta' i suoi bersagli uccidendo anche civili inermi. Il senso di colpa lo opprimera'.

programme.title: Le Notti Di Salem
programme.desc: Tornato alla sua città natale nella speranza di riprendere a scrivere, Ben Mears scopre che è dominata dai vampiri e che l'unico modo per liberarla è entrare a far parte di una banda che sta tentando di sconfiggere queste creature.

programme.title: London Boulevard
programme.desc: Keira Knightley e Colin Farrell in un thriller diretto dallo sceneggiatore di "The Departed". Un'attrice, spaventata dalla notorietà, assume un ex criminale come guardia del corpo.

programme.title: Night Hunter
programme.desc: Thriller con Henry Cavill, Ben Kingsley e Alexandra Daddario. La polizia e un giudice braccano un inafferrabile serial killer dalla personalità multipla che adesca e uccide le donne.

programme.title: L'altro uomo
programme.desc: Thriller di Alfred Hitchcock tratto da un romanzo di Patricia Highsmith. Un miliardario incastra un tennista con un diabolico piano.

programme.title: State a casa
programme.desc: Roan Johnson dirige una dark comedy dal ritmo incalzante con Tommaso Ragno e Dario Aita. Roma: costretti dalla pandemia da Covid-19 a una convivenza forzata nell’appartamento che condividono, quattro ragazzi in difficoltà economica saranno travolti da una nefasta spirale di eventi.

programme.title: The Lodge
programme.desc: Riley Keough in un horror carico di misteri. Durante una bufera, due fratellini rimangono intrappolati in uno chalet con la fidanzata del padre, donna dall'ambiguo passato.

programme.title: The Hanging Sun - Sole di mezzanotte
programme.desc: Dal romanzo di Jo Nesbo, Sky Original di Francesco Carrozzini con Alessandro Borghi. In fuga verso l'estremo Nord, John conosce Lea e Caleb, unica speranza di salvezza da un destino segnato.

programme.title: Detective Marlowe
programme.desc: Thriller Sky Original di Neil Jordan con Liam Neeson, Diane Kruger e Jessica Lange. Hollywood, anni 30: il detective Marlowe e' incaricato di ritrovare l'ex amante di un'ereditiera.

programme.title: L'uomo di neve
programme.desc: Dal bestseller di Jo Nesbo, un thriller con Michael Fassbender, Rebecca Ferguson e Charlotte Gainsbourg, diretto dal regista de "La talpa". Durante l'inverno norvegese, il detective Harry Hole indaga sulla morte di una donna, uccisa nel corso della prima nevicata della stagione. Hole e' convinto che l'omicidio sia legato ad altri delitti avvenuti in passato. In ballo c'e' dunque un serial killer da fermare e l'unico modo per evitare che uccida ancora e' prevenirne le prossime mosse. "L'uomo di neve' e' il settimo romanzo dedicato al detective Harry Hole, il primo adattato per il cinema.

programme.title: Gioco pericoloso
programme.desc: Gioco pericoloso.

programme.title: Il potere dei soldi
programme.desc: Robert Luketic dirige con maestria Gary Oldman e Harrison Ford in uno spy-thriller sullo spietato mondo dell'alta finanza a Wall Street. Dopo aver commesso un imperdonabile errore, un giovane e ambizioso impiegato di una multinazionale ha la possibilita' di riabilitarsi agli occhi del suo capo e salvare il posto. Ma il boss in realta' lo ricatta, costringendolo a farsi assumere dalla societa' concorrente per rubare il prototipo di un nuovo prodotto. Dalla padella nella brace, si accorgera' di essere la semplice pedina di uno sporco gioco.

programme.title: Annientamento
programme.desc: Natalie Portman in un avvincente horror fantascientifico. Dopo che il marito, rientrato dall'Area X, si ammala gravemente, una biologa si unisce ad una spedizione sul posto in cerca di un'eventuale cura. Cio' che l'aspetta e' qualcosa di mostruoso.

programme.title: Il caso Thomas Crawford
programme.desc: Thriller con Anthony Hopkins e Ryan Gosling. Un uomo si auto-accusa dell'omicidio della moglie, che lo tradiva con un poliziotto. Ma il suo è un piano diabolico...

programme.title: La finestra sul cortile
programme.desc: James Stewart e Grace Kelly nel thriller voyeuristico di Alfred Hitchcock. Un fotoreporter costretto all’immobilità spia i vicini del palazzo di fronte e diventa il testimone di un delitto.

programme.title: Un giorno di ordinaria follia
programme.desc: Viaggio allucinato nella follia omicida di un uomo qualunque con Michael Douglas. Il quarantenne William Foster non sta passando un momento facile: lasciato dalla moglie e allontanato dalla figlia in seguito a un'ordinanza del giudice, viene preso da un raptus. Intrappolato in un ingorgo stradale, perde completamente la testa e comincia a uccidere chiunque gli capiti a tiro. Le sue gesta violente fanno il giro della città e del caso viene incaricato un detective (Robert Duvall) al suo ultimo giorno di servizio. Dal regista di "Linea mortale", Joel Schumacher.

programme.title: Il delitto perfetto
programme.desc: Sofisticato capolavoro di Alfred Hitchcock con Ray Milland e Grace Kelly. Per uccidere la ricca moglie, un uomo ricatta un vecchio amico affinche' compia l'omicidio. Ma accade un imprevisto.

programme.title: Il grande Gatsby
programme.desc: Baz Luhrmann (il regista di "Mouline Rouge!") dirige Leonardo DiCaprio, Carey Mulligan e Tobey Maguire nello sfarzoso adattamento, vincitore di due Oscar, del celebre romanzo di Francis S. Fitzgerald, pilastro della letteratura statunitense. America, anni '20: un aspirante scrittore, Nick Carraway, entra nel mondo di Jay Gatsby, un misterioso milionario ossessionato dall'amore impossibile per Daisy: la donna da lui amata e che vorrebbe riconquistare. Nick verra' a contatto con l'atmosfera festosa dell'eta' del jazz che si consuma in illusioni, malinconie e sogni effimeri.

programme.title: Questo o quello: Speciale
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova si confrontano sulla serie Mission: Impossible.

programme.title: Finché notte non ci separi
programme.desc: Pilar Fogliati e Filippo Scicchitano in una commedia romantica tra le strade di Roma. Un biglietto nella tasca di lui farà trascorrere a due neosposi una movimentata prima notte.

programme.title: Matrimonio con sorpresa
programme.desc: Commedia targata HBO. Un imbroglione seduce la figlia di un senatore degli Stati Uniti per impadronirsi dei fondi del padre. Dopo il matrimonio si accorge pero' che ne e' davvero innamorato.

programme.title: Eiffel
programme.desc: Appassionante Sky Original con Romain Duris ed Emma Mackey. Parigi, 1889: l'incontro con una donna amata in passato ispira Gustave Eiffel nella costruzione della celebre torre.

programme.title: Cafe' Society
programme.desc: Commedia di Woody Allen con Jesse Eisenberg, Kristen Stewart e Steve Carell. Anni '30: il giovane Bobby parte per Los Angeles in cerca di fortuna nel cinema e si innamora di Vonnie.

programme.title: Qualcosa di nuovo
programme.desc: Paola Cortellesi e Micaela Ramazzotti in una commedia romantica di Cristina Comencini. Due amiche di vecchia data, e molto diverse tra loro, si contendono l’amore per uno sconosciuto.

programme.title: Book of Love
programme.desc: Sam Claflin in una commedia romantica targata Sky Original. In Messico per promuovere il suo libro uno scrittore inglese scopre che la traduttrice lo ha trasformato in un romanzo erotico.

programme.title: Aline - La voce dell'amore
programme.desc: Valerie Lemercier dirige e interpreta un biopic ispirato alla vita di Celine Dion. Quebec, anni 60: dotata di una voce prodigiosa, la piccola Aline viene scoperta da un noto produttore.

programme.title: Appuntamento con l'amore
programme.desc: Un cast di star hollywoodiane per una commedia sul mistero dell'amore. A ridosso di San Valentino, si intrecciano le storie di coppie innamorate e di single in cerca dell'anima gemella. Persone che si incontrano e si perdono di vista nei modi piu' imprevedibili. Coppie che si sfasciano, altre che si formano, qualcuno incontrera' l'amore della sua vita, qualcun altro vivra' un'avventura fugace, tutto dall'alba al tramonto, a Los Angeles. Dal regista di "Pretty Woman", il film negli Stati Uniti e' uscito nel giorno di San Valentino, incassando al debutto 57 milioni di dollari.

programme.title: Una sirena a Parigi
programme.desc: Marilyn Lima e Nicolas Duvauchelle in una magica avventura su un amore impossibile. Un cantante si prende cura di una sirena ferita, ma cade vittima della sua voce ammaliante.

programme.title: Vi presento Joe Black
programme.desc: Anthony Hopkins e Brad Pitt in una suggestiva pellicola sull'amore e la morte. Un miliardario accoglie il tenebroso fidanzato della figlia, ma è ignaro della sua vera identità.

programme.title: Eiffel
programme.desc: Appassionante Sky Original con Romain Duris ed Emma Mackey. Parigi, 1889: l'incontro con una donna amata in passato ispira Gustave Eiffel nella costruzione della celebre torre.

programme.title: Amici, amanti e...
programme.desc: Dal regista di "Ghostbusters" una commedia piccante con due sex symbol di Hollywood, Natalie Portman e Ashton Kutcher. Adam scopre che suo padre (Kevin Kline) ha sedotto la sua fidanzata. Davanti a un simile trauma, il ragazzo si ubriaca e finisce a casa di Emma. I due, amici di lunga data, finiscono a letto insieme e decidono di instaurare una relazione puramente fisica, senza alcun coinvolgimento: ci si diverte ma i sentimenti devono esser tenuti ben lontani. Un reciproco accordo che sembra anche funzionare, ma sara' sempre piu' difficile tenere a bada il cuore...

programme.desc: Anastasia e Christian, finalmente sposi, credono di essersi lasciati alle spalle il passato, ma un nuovo pericolo minaccia il loro legame.

programme.title: Cinquanta sfumature di nero
programme.desc: Tornano Dakota Johnson e Jamie Dornan nelle avventure sentimental-erotiche tratte dal secondo capitolo della bollente saga letteraria di E. L. James. Christian Grey riesce a riconquistare la fiducia di Anastasia, ma la nuova vita amorosa della coppia sara' minacciata dall'oscuro passato del miliardario, perche' Christian non riesce a disinnescare le sue pulsioni da dominatore. A rendere ancora piu' torbida la situazione ci pensera' l'ingresso in scena di Leila Williams, l'ossessiva ex-fidanzata di Grey, e di Elena Lincoln (Kim Basinger), la donna che inizio' Grey ai piaceri del sadomaso.

programme.desc: Miglior regia a Cannes alla pellicola romantica di Tran Anh Hung con Juliette Binoche. Francia, 1885: il sodalizio tra la cuoca Eugenie e il gastronomo Dodin da' vita a piatti stellati.

programme.title: Proposta indecente
programme.desc: Demi Moore, Woody Harrelson e Robert Redford nell'indimenticabile pellicola firmata dal regista di "Nove settimane e mezzo" e "Attrazione fatale". Diana e David sono una coppia felicemente sposata ma in cattive acque dal punto di vista economico, tanto da tentare la fortuna fra i tavoli e le slot machine di Las Vegas. In loro soccorso arriva l'allettante proposta di un ricco miliardario: un milione di dollari in cambio di una sola notte d'amore con la donna. Dopo molti dubbi, Diana e David decidono di accettare l'offerta ma le conseguenze saranno devastanti...

programme.title: La rivolta delle ex
programme.desc: Matthew McConaughey e Jennifer Garner in una commedia romantica dal tocco soprannaturale. Connor Mead è un celebre fotografo che ha un enorme fascino sulle donne: nessuna riesce a resistergli, e lui da cinico playboy passa da un'avventura all'altra. Per lui non esistono relazioni stabili, tanto meno il matrimonio. E di questo cerca di convincere anche il fratello minore, che invece sta per sposarsi, ma i fantasmi delle sue numerose ex cominciano a perseguitarlo, mostrandogli quello che sarà il suo futuro. Nel cast, anche Michael Douglas.

programme.desc: Cate Blanchett e' una donna alla riscoperta di se stessa in una pellicola di Richard Linklater. Bernadette abbandona la vita da casalinga con la voglia di riappropriarsi delle sue passioni.

programme.desc: Premio a Cannes e una candidatura agli Oscar per la coraggiosa opera di Mohammad Rasoulof. Nell'Iran delle proteste giovanili, l'unione di una famiglia viene messa a dura prova.

Tony D'Amato e i suoi Miami Sharks perdono una partita dietro l'altra, il quarterback titolare e' fuori per infortunio e la giovane e affascinante proprietaria della squadra e' decisa a far fuori il coach. Ma mandarlo via non e' per nulla facile, la squadra e' con Tony e tra un problema e l'altro riesce a qualificarsi per i playoff. Dentro o fuori, non ci sono alternative.

programme.title: Every Breath U Take
programme.desc: A handsome playboy who doesn't believe in love begins to question his outlook when he meets a young woman who has been praying to find her one true love.

programme.title: In My Life
programme.desc: An aging librarian, feeling abandoned by her children who've all moved abroad, travels to New York to spend time with her gay son. There, she tries to start a new life while reconnecting with her son and his new lover. But just as things turn around, she finds out that her son has been keeping a secret from her.

programme.title: Para Sa Hopeless Romantic
programme.desc: A student writer struggles to find a happy ending for her romantic story when her own real life romance falls apart.

programme.title: Hiling
programme.desc: Anna is an ordinary girl who receives an extraordinary birthday gift from a mysterious old woman. Anna discovered that she has given the power to grant any kind of wishes through touching. However, Anna could not do anything to grant her own wishes. She made Trinket’s family rich, who used to get ridiculed by the neighbourhood because of their debts. She also touches a gay who desires to become a real woman. She also touched her hopeless romantic friend Elwood who eventually became the chick magnet of their neighbourhood. She also helped a morose middle-aged woman grow plants that would eventually choke anyone who came across the old lady’s house. She also granted the children’s wish to have a swimming pool on a vacant lot that would cause trouble to the whole people in their community; and a lot, lot more wishes. Anna granted all of her neighbour’s wishes and even the most impossible ones.

programme.title: CSI S4 E20 - Dead Ringer
programme.desc: Season 4 begins with terrific back-to-back episodes involving serial killers (\"Assume Nothing\" / \"For All Our Country\"). There's a new politically minded sheriff in town and in \"Invisible Evidence\" he's ticked off that the CSI's can't get enough evidence to convict a rapist/murderer. Also, Nick and Sara buck for the same promotion. Along the way there are plenty of quirky cases: one involving a museum robbery (\"Suckers\") and one involving a dead juror (\"Eleven Angry Jurors\"). Grissom travels to a small town with plenty of secrets to solve a murder in \"Jackpot,\" Catherine dates a younger man in \"Early Rollout,\" and Sara works a case involving a woman strikingly similar to herself in \"Butterflied.\" There's also plenty of kinkiness in \"Fur and Loathing\" and tragedy \"Bad Words.\".

programme.title: CSI S4 E19 - Bad Words
programme.desc: Season 4 begins with terrific back-to-back episodes involving serial killers (\"Assume Nothing\" / \"For All Our Country\"). There's a new politically minded sheriff in town and in \"Invisible Evidence\" he's ticked off that the CSI's can't get enough evidence to convict a rapist/murderer. Also, Nick and Sara buck for the same promotion. Along the way there are plenty of quirky cases: one involving a museum robbery (\"Suckers\") and one involving a dead juror (\"Eleven Angry Jurors\"). Grissom travels to a small town with plenty of secrets to solve a murder in \"Jackpot,\" Catherine dates a younger man in \"Early Rollout,\" and Sara works a case involving a woman strikingly similar to herself in \"Butterflied.\" There's also plenty of kinkiness in \"Fur and Loathing\" and tragedy \"Bad Words.\".

programme.title: Kita Kita
programme.desc: Lea is a tour guide in Japan who suffered from temporary blindness and if not cured in a few weeks could be permanent. Tonyo who lives right across from Lea is persistent and determined to be her friend. They then become closer and Lea has seen the true character of Tonyo.

programme.title: All Souls Night
programme.desc: Shirley is a caregiver and finds herself working for a strange family living in fear of her father.

programme.title: Ang Panday
programme.desc: Long ago, the evil wizard Lizardo sent an army of monsters to subjugate the land and its people. Lizardo succeeded, but a prophecy tells of a comet that will fall to Earth, and a man who will wield a weapon that will free the people from Lizardo's tyranny. Flavio is a blacksmith content with living a quiet, uneventful life in a town mostly untouched by Lizardo's evil. But when the comet of prophecy lands on the outskirts of town, Flavio's destiny is immediately made clear. Around the peace-loving but brave Flavio. His arch-enemy Lizardo attempts to ruin the peace and harmony of their dwelling place, affecting the inhabitants. Moreover, the evil warlord challenges Flavio by capturing his beautiful lady love Maria. A series of events take place, bringing the blacksmith (panday) at the forefront of a full-blown war against Lizardo's troops.

programme.title: Edward
programme.desc: A public hospital serves as a witness to a young boys rite of passage when he is stuck to take care of his ailing father. Caught in a place where life itself is in limbo, the boy treats the hospital grounds as his playground, not knowing that it will be his source of liberation in the end.

programme.title: Trophy Wife
programme.desc: A man visits his brother to meet his new bride, who turns out to be a former flame. This trophy wife appears to be playing a deadly game of seduction and revenge.

programme.title: Inception
programme.desc: Your mind is the scene of the crime. Box-office superstar Leonardo DiCaprio stars in this contemporary science fiction action film set \"within the architecture of the mind.\" Written, directed and produced by Oscar and Golden Globe nominee Christopher Nolan (The Dark Knight, Batman Begins, The Prestige), this eagerly awaited follow-up to 2008's billion-dollar blockbuster is yet another visionary tale from a startingly original filmmaker who continually raises the bar with every film he makes. Shooting in London, Paris, Tangiers, Calgary and Los Angeles, Nolan's mind-bending film also stars Academy Award winners Michael Caine and Marion Cotillard, in addition to Juno's Ellen Page, Batman Begins' Cillian Murphy and Oscar nominees Ken Watanabe (The Last Samurai) and Tom Berenger (Platoon).

programme.desc: Seorang petarung elit vampir, Selene, berjuang untuk mengakhiri perang abadi antara klan Lycan dan golongan Vampir yang mengkhianatinya.

programme.title: 28 Days Later
programme.desc: Pandemi global nyaris memusnahkan umat manusia usai kawanan simpanse yang terinfeksi virus mematikan dibebaskan. Jim pun memimpin beberapa penyintas untuk menjelajahi London dan menemukan harapan di tengah kekacauan.

programme.title: Nim's Island
programme.desc: Nim tinggal di pulau terpencil bersama ayahnya yang seorang ilmuwan. Ia merupakan penggemar berat penulis buku petualangan Alex Rover. Namun saat sang ayah menghilang, Nim meyakinkan sang penulis untuk membantunya.

programme.title: 3:10 To Yuma
programme.desc: Dan menawarkan diri untuk mengantar pemimpin geng perampok, Ben Wade, ke stasiun kereta guna dibawa ke pengadilan. Namun, anggota geng Ben yang terdiri dari pembunuh dan perampok memiliki rencana lain.

programme.title: The World's End
programme.desc: Lima teman masa kecil bersatu kembali dua puluh tahun setelah mereka mencoba mabuk-mabukan di beberapa bar sekaligus dalam semalam dan berusaha untuk mendatangi sebuah bar legendaris: The World's End.

programme.title: Backdraft
programme.desc: Sepasang kakak beradik yang bekerja sebagai petugas pemadam kebakaran di Chicago kesulitan mengesampingkan masalah pribadi mereka saat menghadapi serangkaian kasus pembakaran mematikan yang mengancam kota.

programme.title: Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Pt 1

programme.desc: Sebuah keluarga mencoba untuk menghentikan ancaman suatu badai dahsyat yang membayangi dan memastikan bahwa manusia tidak akan musnah.
